name: Orascom Development Holding
source: Orascom Development Holding AG Annual Report 2024, consolidated financial statements (audited by Deloitte AG, report dated 26 March 2025)
note: Consolidated cash flow statement, CHF absolute units. Capital Expenditure is payments for property, plant and equipment and investment property, stored negative as the dataset convention. Free Cash Flow is derived as Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure. Net Change in Cash is the printed net increase in cash and bank balances; the printed effects of exchange rate changes on cash (FY2024: (49564347); FY2023: (41374294)) are not represented in the panel row set.
